# One Patch (Overbaker/One-Patch)

> Lightweight (~1.5 MB), 100% offline open-source Android utility (Kotlin, MIT) that places a draggable, resizable rectangular touch-blocking overlay on any region of your screen to stop cracked-screen ghost touches, accidental palm hits, or unwanted UI triggers — with a one-tap floating toggle and recordable one-handed-mode gesture replay.

## Key Facts

- **Zero Root & Zero Internet**: Uses standard Android `TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY` (or `TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY` when Accessibility Service is enabled). Declares **no `INTERNET` permission** — fully offline, zero telemetry.
- **Tiny Footprint**: ~1.5 MB release APK (`minSdk 26` / Android 8.0+, `targetSdk 34`, Material You dynamic colors on Android 12+).
- **Smart Controls**: Floating Action Button (single tap = toggle pause/resume, double tap = force bypass + replay recorded one-handed gesture, long-press drag = reposition) plus Quick Toggle activity alias for OEM back-tap / quick ball triggers.
- **Recordable One-Handed Gesture**: Record your device's exact OEM one-handed trigger gesture once (HyperOS, OneUI, ColorOS, etc.) and replay with resolution-independent coordinate rescaling.
- **Known Android Boundaries**: Cannot block status bar, IME keyboard, system gesture bars, or apps setting `HIDE_OVERLAY_WINDOWS` (banking/password views). Xiaomi HyperOS one-handed SurfaceFlinger transform is tracked in Issue `#1` with an auto-bypass workaround.
